summary.text: Jason Hitt is an independent candidate for the Tennessee House of Representatives, District 23, in the November 3, 2026 general election, alongside incumbent Mark Cochran (R) and independent Jeremy Bromwell.
An educator, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his key messages are support for public education, support for the Second Amendment, and equality for all under the law.
